description: This file implements a file-backed in-memory store for Matrix sync data, including persistence, loading, and synchronization logic, with features like atomic file writing and shutdown handling.

classes.name: FileBackedMatrixSyncStore
classes.description: A class extending MemoryStore that manages Matrix sync data with file persistence, including load, save, delete, and shutdown handling.

methods.name: hasSavedSync
methods.description: Returns whether a saved sync exists from initial load.

methods.name: hasSavedSyncFromCleanShutdown
methods.description: Indicates if the last load was a clean shutdown with saved sync.

methods.name: getSavedSync
methods.description: Retrieves a clone of the saved sync data.

methods.name: getSavedSyncToken
methods.description: Returns the sync token associated with the saved sync.

methods.name: setSyncData
methods.description: Updates the store with new sync data and schedules persistence.

methods.name: storeClientOptions
methods.description: Stores client options and schedules persistence.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Forces a save if 'force' is true, otherwise does nothing.

methods.name: wantsSave
methods.description: Indicates whether the store wants to be saved periodically (always false here).

methods.name: deleteAllData
methods.description: Deletes all stored data and removes the persistence file.

methods.name: markCleanShutdown
methods.description: Marks the current shutdown as clean for future load considerations.

methods.name: markDirtyAndSchedulePersist
methods.description: Marks the store as dirty and schedules a persistence after debounce delay.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Performs atomic write of current store state to disk.
